title: Loading a .pck breaks the Global Class List
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7
- Reproducible in 4.7.2
- Not Reproducible in 4.4
- Not Reproducible in 4.6.3

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

There seems to be an issue with retrieving the global class list using `ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list()`
The issue seems to arise if a Pack is loaded through `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack()`

I've tried to replicate it in other version and I've found some weirdness. When trying to import a .pck file created at earlier versions the bug does not happen, making me think the issue exists on how the .pck is created rather than the loading of it, but uncertain.

### Steps to reproduce

Load the project on Godot 4.7 and run it.

Press the `Print Classes` button. You will see this printed to the log
```
[{ "base": &"Control", "class": &"Main", "icon": "", "is_abstract": false, "is_tool": false, "language": &"GDScript", "path": "res://node.gd" }, { "base": &"Node", "class": &"Test1", "icon": "", "is_abstract": false, "is_tool": false, "language": &"GDScript", "path": "res://Scripts/Test1.gd" }, { "base": &"Node", "class": &"Test2", "icon": "", "is_abstract": false, "is_tool": false, "language": &"GDScript", "path": "res://Scripts/Test2.gd" }]
```

Its a list of 3 classes that exist in the project.
After that click on the `Import.pck` button, this will import a .pck file that exists in the project files containing only 1 class script using `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack()`

You will get a print in the log if the loading was successful. If it was press the `Print Classes` button again. If it all worked "correctly" you will now see this in the console

```
[{ "base": &"Control", "class": &"Main", "icon": "", "is_abstract": false, "is_tool": false, "language": &"GDScript", "path": "res://node.gd" }]
```

You will now see only 1 class is printed

If a .pck generated in easier versions is used, the issue is not there and all classes are printed normally.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[global-class-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33275973/global-class-bug.zip)
